CP.label: checked proof
CP.meaning: Proof read and following from stated antecedents.

SC.label: completed symbolic check
SC.meaning: Verified by an exact symbolic or integer-exact computation.

NC.label: completed numerical check
NC.meaning: Verified numerically to a stated tolerance; not a symbolic proof.

ST.label: standard imported theorem
ST.meaning: Independently established standard mathematics; the manuscript re-derives it.

MA.label: manuscript assertion
MA.meaning: Claim or proof exists only inside the manuscript; not yet independently checked.

AX.label: assumption or axiom
AX.meaning: Granted starting point: axiom, definition, or constitutional rule. Not proved.

IN.label: incomplete or failed computation
IN.meaning: Computation timed out, failed, or is still running.

IC.label: incorrect result
IC.meaning: The claim as stated fails; the ledger records how.
